process_area.title: Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations

value_stream.name: Bulky & White-Goods Delivery, Installation, Haul-Away & Recycling Operations

fields.Participants: DC Ops (VS-04), Store Ops (VS-07), Crews/Drivers, 3PL (VS-56), Customer Service (VS-13)
fields.Volume: Per-day manifests × ~each serving DC/store; each manifest = multi-stop two-man route

workflows.name: Daily Delivery Manifest, Load Planning & Dispatch

Automation Opportunity: - Auto time-window sequencing; e-manifest to crew device; load-verification scan; live ETA to customer
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: manifest-vs-load verification at staging; crew-license match before dispatch (W4293)
Cross-references: - links to VS-04 (DC), VS-06.3 (routing), VS-13/VS-75 (comms), W4291 (scheduling), W4293 (crew), W4294 (vehicle)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Load-sequence risk**: wrong stop order → re-handle/damage/time loss; mitigated by reverse-stop load plan
- **Mismatch risk**: wrong item/install-kit loaded → failed install; mitigated by manifest-vs-load verification at staging

steps.activity: Dispatch/DC build the day's manifest from confirmed orders — sequence by time-window + zone, group by vehicle type (W4294), and assign two-man crews by install-license match (W4293)

DC Ops pick/stage bulky items, verify against manifest (item, install-kit, haul-away flag), load in reverse-stop order with securing equipment, and release to crew with e-manifest + customer instructions
Dispatch push e-manifest to crew device, send customer ETA notifications (VS-75/VS-13), and track in real-time against the route

workflows.name: In-Home Delivery Execution, Site Protection & Handoff

Automation Opportunity: - Crew-app carry-path checklist; photo e-POD of placement; auto-prompt haul-away/recycling capture
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: site protection used; team-lift SOP; handoff captured (e-POD) before crew departure
Cross-references: - links to VS-06.3 (delivery app), VS-13 (service), VS-23 (exception), W4299 (install), W4305 (haul-away), W4301 (acceptance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Property-damage risk**: appliance scratches floor/wall during carry; mitigated by site protection + trained carry path
- **Access-blocker risk**: unforeseen obstruction (narrow stair, low elevator) blocks delivery; mitigated by pre-delivery access check + on-site re-plan/escalation (W4302)
System Touchpoints: - e-POD/crew app (VS-06.3); order (VS-16); customer comms (VS-13); LP/exception (VS-23)

steps.activity: Crew verify customer/identity and site access, lay floor/wall protection, and plan the carry path (stairs/elevator/clearances) per the pre-delivery check (W4292)
Crew team-lift/roll the item to the install location using equipment (W4294), set in place, remove packaging, and collect for haul-away/recycling where applicable (W4305)
Crew hand off to installer if separate (W4299) or complete placement, brief the customer on use/care, and capture handoff confirmation

fields.Owner: Licensed Installer / Bulky-Delivery Service Ops / Installation Services (VS-12)
fields.Participants: Installer (W4293), Crew, Customer Service (VS-13), Quality (VS-31), HSE (VS-24)
fields.Volume: Install-tagged orders (split-AC, water heater, washing machine, cooker, rangehood, dishwasher)

Automation Opportunity: - Category install-SOP on installer app; mandatory leak-test photo capture; auto warranty-registration; install-fee auto-post
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: installer licensed (W4293); leak/safety test documented; warranty registered (VS-53); install evidence captured
Cross-references: - links to VS-12 (install services), VS-53 (warranty), VS-16/VS-17 (revenue), VS-31 (quality), VS-24 (HSE), W4293 (license), W4300 (quality)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Refrigerant/gas-safety risk**: improper split-AC refrigerant or gas hookup → leak/fire/health + RA 8749 Clean Air Act violation; mitigated by licensed installer (W4293) + leak-test SOP
- **Warranty-void risk**: install not registered → manufacturer warranty dispute; mitigated by mandatory install/warranty registration at completion

steps.activity: Installer perform the hookup/commissioning per category SOP — electrical (cooker/washer), plumbing (washer/dishwasher/water heater), refrigerant split-AC (vacuum/charge/leak-test per RA 8749 Clean Air Act), gas (cooker — gas-safe), and venting (rangehood/dryer)
Installer test function, leak/safety-check (gas leak, refrigerant leak, electrical, level/stability), brief the customer on operation/maintenance, and hand over manuals/warranty card
Installer register the install/warranty (VS-53), capture install evidence (photos, serial, completion), and post the install-fee/service revenue (VS-16/VS-17)

fields.Owner: Bulky-Delivery Service Ops / Quality (VS-31) / Damage Claims (VS-90)
fields.Participants: Crew/Installer, Customer Service (VS-13), Quality (VS-31), Vendor (VS-03), Claims (VS-90), LP (VS-23)
fields.Trigger: Damage found at delivery; defect-on-arrival; install-quality issue

Automation Opportunity: - e-POD damage-photo → auto-claim draft; serial-based DOA check; concession/refund workflow; root-cause tagging
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: damage/defect documented at delivery (e-POD evidence); claim filed vs liable party (VS-90/VS-03); concession within RA authority (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-31 (quality), VS-90 (damage claims), VS-03 (vendor), VS-16/VS-118 (refund), VS-23 (LP), W4296 (analytics), W4302 (redelivery)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Evidence risk**: damage not documented at delivery → unrecoverable claim (vs carrier/vendor) and customer dispute; mitigated by mandatory photo+decision capture on e-POD at the doorstep
- **Liability-attribution risk**: transit vs DOA vs install error unclear → claim ping-pong; mitigated by triage SOP and serial/evidence trail
System Touchpoints: - e-POD/exception (VS-06.3); quality/RMA (VS-31); damage claims (VS-90); vendor (VS-03); order/refund (VS-16/VS-118); LP (VS-23)
Time Estimate: - ~15–30 min per field exception; claim resolution days–weeks

steps.activity: Crew/Installer detect and document damage/defect at the point of delivery/install (photo, serial, nature), offer the customer options (accept-as-is with concession, refuse, swap), and capture the decision on e-POD

Service Ops/Quality triage — transit damage (vs VS-06/VS-56 carrier), manufacturing defect (vs VS-31/VS-03 vendor DOA), or install error — and trigger recovery: redelivery (W4302), vendor RMA (VS-90/VS-31), or field repair
Claims/LP file the claim against the liable party (carrier VS-90, vendor VS-03), process customer concession/refund/swap (VS-16/VS-118), and feed root-cause to prevention (W4296)

fields.Participants: Customer, Service Ops, CX (VS-13), Warranty (VS-53), Finance (VS-16)

workflows.name: Customer Acceptance, e-POD, Warranty Registration & Satisfaction Capture

Automation Opportunity: - e-sign e-POD → auto revenue recognition + warranty registration; auto NPS survey; service-recovery workflow on low score
Controls: - CTL-81 (ensure bulky delivery compliance & e-POD closure.)
- CTL-660: customer acceptance captured before crew departure; revenue recognized on acceptance; warranty registered (VS-53)
Cross-references: - links to VS-16/VS-17 (revenue), VS-53 (warranty), VS-13 (CX), VS-05 (inventory), W4299 (install), W4300 (exceptions)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Revenue-timing risk**: acceptance not captured → revenue/AR held; mitigated by e-POD-acceptance → auto revenue recognition
- **Warranty-gap risk**: warranty unregistered → future claim dispute; mitigated by auto-registration from install evidence

steps.activity: Crew capture customer acceptance (signature/e-sign on e-POD), confirm item condition + install function, and trigger revenue recognition / release of any hold (VS-16/VS-17)
System auto-register warranty (VS-53) from install evidence, post the sale/install to revenue (VS-17), and update inventory/AR (VS-05/VS-16)
CX send post-delivery satisfaction capture (NPS/survey), capture issues, and close the loop with service recovery if low score (VS-13)

fields.Frequency: Per failed attempt (benchmark 3–8% of bulky deliveries)
fields.Participants: Crew, Customer Service (VS-13), Logistics (VS-06), Finance (VS-118), Revenue Assurance (VS-118)
fields.Trigger: Customer not at home; access blocked; item unfit; customer reschedule

Automation Opportunity: - Auto pre-delivery reminder (SMS/app); no-show fee auto-apply; self-service reschedule; failed-attempt cost analytics
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: failed-attempt evidenced; re-delivery fee per policy (W4295); cancellation/restocking within authority (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (service), VS-06.3 (delivery), VS-16/VS-118 (refund), W4291 (reschedule), W4295 (fees), W4296 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-waste risk**: failed attempts consume crew/vehicle capacity; mitigated by reminder comms + slot-deposit/no-show policy
- **Customer-experience risk**: opaque reschedule → churn/chargeback; mitigated by proactive contact + clear re-delivery policy

steps.activity: Crew report failed-attempt reason (not-at-home, access, unfit site, refused) with evidence (photo/attempt log) and item returned-to-DC/store or held
Customer Service contact customer, reschedule into a new slot (W4291), and apply any re-delivery/attempt fee per policy (W4295) within RA authority
Revenue Assurance/Finance track failed-attempt cost, apply cancellation/restocking where customer cancels, and feed repeat-failure analytics to prevention (W4296)

workflows.name: Subcontracted/3PL Bulky Delivery Partner Operations & SLA

Automation Opportunity: - 3PL SLA dashboard; 3PL data auto-ingest into dispatch/POD; insurance/bonding expiry tracking
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: 3PL specialist terms + insurance/bonding (VS-26); SLA-governed; HSE-compliant (W4304)
Cross-references: - links to VS-56 (3PL), VS-34 (procurement), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-26 (insurance), VS-24 (HSE), W4290 (capacity), W4304 (safety)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capability-mismatch risk**: generic 3PL lacks lift-gate/licensed installer → failed/damaged install; mitigated by specialist contract terms + onboarding validation
- **Liability risk**: 3PL-caused damage/injury attributed to BuildRight; mitigated by contract liability + insurance/bonding (VS-26)
Time Estimate: - ~2–3 weeks per contract cycle; ongoing governance

steps.activity: Procurement/Legal embed bulky-delivery terms in 3PL contracts (specialist vehicle/crew requirement, install-license, haul-away/recycle obligation, SLA, liability/damage, insurance, data) and onboard partners
Partner Mgmt govern day-to-day 3PL performance vs SLA (on-time, install-complete, damage, haul-away completion, customer acceptance), and integrate 3PL data into the dispatch/POD system
Finance/HSE audit 3PL cost, insurance/bonding, HSE compliance (W4304), and enforce consequence/breach per contract

workflows.name: Field Service Safety, DOLE OSH, Heavy-Lifting & Customer-Premises Liability

Automation Opportunity: - Pre-task hazard-check app; incident-reporting mobile; insurance-claim workflow; ERM auto-feed
Controls: - CTL-660 (ensure controlled execution — Delivery Execution, Installation & In-Home Service Operations (PA-143.2).)
- CTL-660: field-service SOP per DOLE OSH; PPE/lift-gate used; incidents reported & insured (VS-26); risks in ERM (VS-21.2)
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-19/VS-98 (crew), VS-21.2 (ERM), VS-26 (insurance), VS-100.3 (legal), W4293 (training), W4294 (equipment)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Injury risk**: heavy-lifting/appliance-handling injury to crew; mitigated by team-lift + lift-gate + OSH training + PPE
- **Customer-premises-liability risk**: property damage/personal injury at customer site; mitigated by site protection, conduct SOP, and insurance (VS-26)
Time Estimate: - Standard ~2 weeks; pre-task check ~5 min/task; per-incident investigation variable

steps.activity: HSE/Delivery Ops set the field-service safety standard (manual-handling/team-lift, lift-gate use, appliance securing, electrical/gas/refrigerant install safety, customer-premises conduct) per DOLE OSH
Crews/Installers execute pre-task hazard check, use required PPE/equipment (W4294), and report incidents/near-miss immediately

steps.a: HSE Mgr / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: HSE/Legal/Insurance manage incidents (injury, property damage, customer-premises liability), investigate, file insurance (VS-26), and feed the risk register (VS-21.2)
